sections.title: Joke Request
sections.content:
Sure, here's a classic one for you: 

Why don't we ever tell secrets on a farm? Because the potatoes have eyes, the corn has ears, and the beans stalk.

sections.title: Run Electron App
sections.content:
This command changes into the `app` directory and launches your Electron app using `npx`:

```bash
cd app && npx electron .
```
